direction_notes: All four conditions changed EEG band power versus baseline; uni- and bilateral stimulation differed significantly in some bands, with no clear single direction.

exposures.label: Uni- and bilateral LIPUS of motor cortex

target.label: right and left primary motor cortex

device.manufacturer: In-house built (PZT from Steiner & Martins Inc.)

timing.protocol_description: Sonication duration 300 ms, inter-stimulus interval 2 s, 200 trials per condition; conditions 1 kHz PRF with 50% DC or 100 Hz PRF with 5% DC applied unilaterally to the right M1 or bilaterally in combination.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Nine Sprague-Dawley rats (7–10 weeks old male, 220–280 g) were used for this study.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: All stimulation conditions were performed with a central frequency of 380 kHz, SD of 300 ms, inter-stimulus interval (ISI) of 2 s, and spatialpeak pulse-average intensity (I<sub>SPPA</sub>) of 2.3 W/cm<sup>2</sup>, as shown in Figure 2.

source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: The right primary motor (M1) cortex was selected to evaluate the efect of unilateral LIPUS stimulation with one of two sonication schemes: 1 kHz PRF and 50% DC (stimulation condition #1), 100 Hz PRF and 5% DC (stimulation condition #4).
